tasks.objective: Produce the TM108 (TM108_HSKP_VAC1_PRST) VS C++ implementation from the signed test-method contract (t5) and the signed resource/config contract (t4) as code plus a staged patch, an implementation manifest that validates against team/schemas/implementation-manifest.schema.json, and a terminal report — with zero invented electrical, method or code-placement decisions, and every unresolved open item carried as an explicit PENDING marker.
acceptance: Implementation manifest exists and passes the frozen schema: `python scripts/validate_team_artifact.py implementation-manifest team/artifacts/tm108-v2-trial/implementation/tm108-implementation-manifest.json` exits 0, with targetRoot = D:/PROJECT6-DALI/ForCodexDebug, non-empty backups and changes, and before/after sha256 for every changed file.

The nine contract phases P0 pre-state, P1 closure, P2 VBAT on, P3 register activation, P4 rising sweep capture, P5 turn-around hold, P6 falling sweep capture, P7 bounded settle + stimulus de-energise, P8 closure release + safe end state exist in the code in that order, each carrying its prerequisite, relay group, register activation, setpoint/ramp/delay and exit condition as signed in contract md section 3.

Closure set is exactly {13, 65} with K17 required-closed but no invented source for its actuation; the register staircase writes entertestmode() first, then DMUX_EN=1 with DMUX_SEL=22 as one directive, and no de-activation write is invented (RT-3 cited as open).

The measurement is the two-segment rampv_capv (rising capture during P4, falling capture during P6) producing the three logged parameters Rise / Fall / Hys(mV) with the calculation and units of contract md section 4 and the log fields/units/precision of section 6; no tolerance or pass/fail threshold is invented while RT-4 is open.

Three-step power-down and the safe end state of contract md section 5 are implemented, with the BST-SW differential (0 V <= BST_actual - SW_actual <= 5 V) not asserted for any phase: all nine phases stay marked as unevaluated (RT-2 / OI-T5-02), never SW=0 V by default.

Every observation-endpoint-dependent site carries an explicit PENDING-OI-T4-01 marker and no line treats DTEST0 as nQON; F1-F6 stay two-sided with no side selected; RT-1 (K13 conflict) is closed at P1 / released at P8 and reported, not silently resolved.

No source table, route, relay, register field, functional relay or isolation condition outside the signed t4 boundary is added; the staged patch is a truthful representation of the manifest changes (apply-and-hash-check reproducible), and the terminal report is written in the LAZY_AGENT_TEAM_RUNTIME.md format with paths plus sha256.

D:/PROJECT6-DALI/devel is not read-modified, not written, and not used as a patch target; if the filesystem sandbox denies the write into D:/PROJECT6-DALI/ForCodexDebug, the denial is recorded verbatim and escalated once for approval, and the staged patch plus manifest are still delivered.
